# The corpus `$GEN.USER_AGENT` picks from (#1112): one real browser User-Agent per line, as the
# browser itself sends it — never a synthesised string, since a made-up UA is worse than none.
# Embedded at compile time; nothing is fetched at send time. Blank lines and `#` lines are
# ignored. Refresh by replacing the version numbers with current stable releases; Chromium's
# reduced UA freezes everything after the major (`139.0.0.0`) and Android's model (`K`).
# Last refreshed: 2026-09.
